archive_run_id.description: Stable identifier for one broadcast/archive run.

worker_video_ingest.description: Internal opt-in requesting a per-job SRT listener for the assigned Worker scene video. Existing callers omit this field.

worker_video_ingest_token.description: Short-lived job-scoped token authorizing the Worker video ingest allocation. It is internal request data and must never appear in logs, audit metadata, process status, or public API responses.

stream_key_secret_name.description: Runtime secret reference resolved by the assigned Encoder/Recorder through the Control Panel. This is preferred for stored YouTube outputs and YouTube Live API short-lived stream keys.

started_at.description: Archive run start time. Required when archive_run_id is present.

youtube_runtime.description: Non-secret YouTube lifecycle metadata prepared by Control Panel. A canonical public YouTube watch URL may be included for a prepared live_api_relay_static runtime; raw stream keys and OAuth tokens must not be included here.

video_cover_start.description: Desired Video Cover start snapshot. New Control Panel producers send this snapshot for both active and inactive desired state so Encoder can bind the visual epoch before GET/reconcile. Whole-field omission remains accepted only for legacy callers during compatibility.
